title: Prompt-Level Distillation: A Non-Parametric Alternative to Model Fine-Tuning for Efficient Reasoning
measurement_description: The paper uses the StereoSet dataset to measure stereotypical biases learned by language models. One of the four domains of bias measured is Religion, where the model's task is to predict the correct underlying domain (e.g., Religion) from an isolated context sentence.
findings: The paper's proposed method, Prompt-Level Distillation (PLD), significantly improves the performance of compact models on the StereoSet benchmark. For instance, Gemma-3 4B's macro-F1 score on StereoSet, which includes a religion category, increased from 0.57 (zero-shot) to 0.90 after applying PLD. This demonstrates the method's effectiveness in transferring reasoning capabilities for stereotype detection tasks.
